name: Axi Docs
summary: Workspace documentation hub combining a React reader, knowledge-source adapters, knowledge graph, MCP document bus, and generated project dossier mirrors.

entrypoints.purpose: Mount the React documentation reader and knowledge hub.
Expose the Axi Docs MCP and HTTP document-access surfaces.
Generate workspace project dossier mirrors and their index.

services: Blinko when the Blinko source is enabled
Anthropic-compatible API when AI document analysis is enabled
Aliyun OSS when attachment upload hooks are enabled

variables.name: AXI_DOCS_BOUNDED_AGENT_TOKEN

variables.source: app/.env or process environment; defaults to human

provides: Versioned read-only context and approval-only effect proposals for bounded Agents

active: Keep the project documentation contract and generated dossier coverage complete.

Continue the VitePress-aligned reader experience and source governance milestone.
knownFailures: TODO.md records remaining security, asynchronous I/O, CORS, architecture, UX, and test-coverage work.
Live Blinko, AI analysis, and OSS integrations require their corresponding external services and credentials.

troubleshooting.symptom: Governance or documentation checks report missing files.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: A required root or app governance document was removed, renamed, or not generated.
troubleshooting.resolution: Run pnpm --dir app docs:check, restore the named file from its authoritative source, and rerun the check.

troubleshooting.symptom: Source checks report a lock mismatch or unavailable documentation source.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: A configured external source moved or its locked revision no longer matches the local checkout.
troubleshooting.resolution: Inspect docs/sources.lock.json and the configured source path, then update the lock only after verifying the intended revision.

troubleshooting.symptom: The build fails while optional live integrations are unavailable.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: A source adapter or environment-dependent path is being treated as required during build.
troubleshooting.resolution: Check app/.env.example and app/AGENTS.md, disable the optional source or provide its documented local configuration, then rerun pnpm --dir app verify.
